summary: Hernandez's F rating is anchored in a Hindu American PAC endorsement from a Hindutva organization. She also received independent spending support from United Democracy Project, an AIPAC-backed super PAC, and from BOLD America, which the record documents as having received UDP funding in 2026. At an April 2026 Indivisible Tri-Valley forum, she declined to label Israel's Gaza actions as genocide, diverging from fellow candidates and the Alameda County Democratic Party.
